text:
oliver: Heads up: seeing a cluster in us-west2 where small gpu pods are Pending despite overall free GPU capacity. Not normal.

ops-bot: ALERT: 5341 - PodPending spike in us-west2-gpu-pool (10 -> 78).

mike: Which nodes? any taints? can you paste `kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o wide`?

oliver: Quick dump:
```
NAME            STATUS   ROLES   AGE   GPU  IP
gw-node-a-1     Ready    node    12d   4    10.0.3.11
gw-node-a-2     Ready    node    11d   2    10.0.3.12
...             ...
```
Pods stuck with `0/4 nodes are available: 4 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu` but nodes show free gpu utilization 10%.

sarah: Are they using nodeAffinity or strict topologySpread? Any nodeSelector on those pods?

oliver: They're tiny inference pods requesting gpu:1, affinity preferred to `rack:gpu` but not required. kube-scheduler logs show `filtering: failed predicate: NodeSelector` for a subset.

mike: Also seeing NIC errors on gw-node-a-2 in node-exporter: `netdev eth0 tx dropped`. Could be kubelet marking conditions? Can you `kubectl describe node gw-node-a-2`?

oliver: From describe: `Taints: gpu-unavailable:NoSchedule` added by our inflight daemon because of a transient NVLINK error and then never removed. We have an autoscaler that skips tainted nodes.

jen: Ah, daemon that marks nodes on NIC or GPU errors didn't clear after kernel module recovery. We had a couple of kernel oops last week. I can push a fix to the cleanup hook to untaint after probe pass.

sarah: Short-term: can we manually remove taint on the 3 nodes and let scheduler place pending pods? `kubectl taint nodes gw-node-a-2 gpu-unavailable:NoSchedule-`

mike: :thumbsup: I'll run it in 2 mins and watch eviction patterns. Also propose we run a quick packer job to defragment: cordon and drain low-util nodes into higher-util ones then uncordon to consolidate.

oliver: After removing taints, pods started placing. 60/78 scheduled. Still seeing a backlog of tiny pods in a couple AZs.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: reduced by 80% after taint removal. Follow-up: create automatic untaint-on-recovery in the node-probe and add metric `node_taint_sticky`.

jen: I'll open a PR with the cleanup hook + test. Also will add a periodic job to reconcile taints older than 15m.

sarah: Longer term: let's tweak scheduler weighting to prefer pack small-gpu pods into warm pools to avoid fragmentation. Filing a doc/PR.
